chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar al-Bāqir عليه السلام said: “If I had reached ʿIkrimah at the time of death, I would have benefited him.”
Then it was said to al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, “By what would he have benefited him?” He said: “He would have instructed him in what you are upon.”

key_terms.الْمَوْتِ: death; the final moment when a person departs this world
key_terms.لَنَفَعْتُهُ: I would have benefited him; provided him with something spiritually beneficial
key_terms.مَا أَنْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ: what you are upon; the belief and doctrine held by the مخاطَبين
key_terms.يُلَقِّنُهُ: he would instruct him; prompt him with words or belief at death

ai.seo_question: How can right belief benefit a person at the time of death according to Imam al-Baqir and Imam al-Sadiq عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates that at the moment of death, being instructed in the true creed and right belief is of great benefit. It highlights the importance of adherence to the truth taught by the Imams عليهم السلام, especially at the final moments of life.
